board.agent.agentBusy.text: {agent} {status, select, working {is working. Start the task once it's idle, or give it to another agent.} starting {is starting. Start the task once it's idle, or give it to another agent.} waiting {is waiting for the user. Start the task once it's idle, or give it to another agent.} background {is waiting on background tasks it started. Start the task once it's idle, or give it to another agent.} other {is waiting on cards (a card watch): it takes no other work until it is woken. If it builds a lane, put the card in that lane where it should go (cw_lane start), and Combwork starts it on {agent} in turn; otherwise give it to another agent, or leave {agent} a message for the work it waits on (cw_message_agent), which wakes it and keeps its watch.}}
board.agent.agentBusy.note: #910: the words the Agent API always gave (the window says card). status: what the agent is doing (working, starting, waiting, background; other: a card watch). HI-3361: a watch may never end (a lane's builder goes from one to the next) and only the user cancels one, so a watching agent's ways on are its lane, another agent or a message.

board.agent.chooseProject.text: Choose a project before giving the task to an agent.
board.agent.chooseProject.note: #910: the words the Agent API always gave (the window says card).

board.agent.needsTitle.note: #910: the words the Agent API always gave (the window says card).

board.agent.unknownTask.note: #910: the words the Agent API always gave (the window says card). Also what a confined agent is told about a card outside its project.

board.error.inUse.text: Another Combwork has this workspace open: close it first.
board.error.inUse.note: An error: the board can't be upgraded to 1.0 (or its 0.9 backup put back) while another copy of Combwork (an older version, or another profile) has the workspace open. Nothing was changed.

board.error.newer.text: This board was saved by a newer version of Combwork. It is shown read-only: update Combwork to change it.
board.error.newer.note: An error: the workspace's task board was saved by a newer Combwork, whose format this version doesn't know; cards can be read but not changed.

board.error.noBackup.text: There is no 0.9 board backup to put back: this board was never upgraded to 1.0 here.
board.error.noBackup.note: An error from Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup…: no copy of the board from before its upgrade to 1.0 is kept in the workspace.

board.error.noWorkspace.note: An error: the task board needs an open workspace, and there is none.

board.error.stopAgentsFirst.text: Stop this workspace's agents and its Assistant first: once the 0.9 board is back, Combwork can't record them.
board.error.stopAgentsFirst.note: An error from Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup…: agents of the workspace are running or starting; the board put back is read-only in this Combwork, so their sessions couldn't be recorded. Nothing was changed.

board.error.unavailable.note: An error: the workspace's task board database couldn't be opened or its cards couldn't be moved into it; {error} says why (from the system, often in English). Nothing was lost: the cards are still where they were.

board.error.upgradeFirst.text: This board is from version 0.9: it is read-only until it is upgraded to 1.0 (Upgrade… on the board's banner).
board.error.upgradeFirst.note: An error: the workspace's task board hasn't been upgraded to 1.0's format yet (the user was asked and said not now), so cards can be read but not changed. Upgrade… is the button on the banner above the board.

board.error.upgradeFirstStart.text: This workspace is from version 0.9: upgrade it to 1.0 before starting agents (Upgrade… on the banner at the top of the window).
board.error.upgradeFirstStart.note: An error: an agent (or the Assistant) can't start while the workspace's data waits for its upgrade to 1.0's format (the user said Not Now): Combwork couldn't record its session. Upgrade… is the button on the banner at the top of the window.

board.work.changes.noRepository.text: This project has no repository to read the revision from.
board.work.changes.noRepository.note: A card's revision diff couldn't be shown: the card's project has no version control (None).

board.work.changes.noRevision.text: This submission has no revision to compare: its commits weren't recorded.
board.work.changes.noRevision.note: A card's revision diff couldn't be shown: the submission recorded no base or revision commit (a no-code card, or one from before revisions were recorded).

board.work.changes.noSubmission.text: This card has no such submission.
board.work.changes.noSubmission.note: A card's revision diff couldn't be shown: the submission it names isn't one of the card's (the card changed meanwhile).

board.work.changes.notListed.text: {path} isn't one of this submission's files.
board.work.changes.notListed.note: A card's revision diff couldn't be shown: the file isn't among the files the submission changed.

board.work.comments.binary.text: Lines of a binary file, or of one too large to compare, can’t be commented on.
board.work.comments.binary.note: A line comment couldn't be added: the file is binary, or too large for its diff to be shown.

board.work.comments.changed.text: That comment was changed meanwhile: look at it again.
board.work.comments.changed.note: A line comment's edit couldn't be saved: someone changed the comment since it was opened for editing.

board.work.comments.empty.note: A line comment on a card's revision diff couldn't be saved: its text is empty.

board.work.comments.lines.text: Lines {from} to {to} aren’t in that side of {path}.
board.work.comments.lines.note: A line comment couldn't be added: the lines it names ({from} to {to}: line numbers, never formatted as amounts) aren't in that side (the original or the changed version) of the file {path}.

board.work.comments.noCard.text: This card’s work can’t be read, so it can’t take comments.
board.work.comments.noCard.note: A line comment couldn't be saved: the card's work record (its facts) can't be read: a card from before 1.0, or its project has none.

board.work.comments.noComment.text: That comment is no longer on this card.
board.work.comments.noComment.note: A line comment couldn't be changed: it was deleted meanwhile.

board.work.comments.sent.text: A comment sent to the builder can’t be deleted: resolve it instead.
board.work.comments.sent.note: A line comment couldn't be deleted: it was already sent to the card's builder, so it can only be resolved. Glossary: builder.

board.work.comments.tooLong.text: A comment can be at most {max, number} characters.
board.work.comments.tooLong.note: A line comment on a card's revision diff couldn't be saved: its text is longer than {max} characters.

board.work.comments.tooMany.text: This card has {max, number} open comments already: resolve some first.
board.work.comments.tooMany.note: A line comment couldn't be added or reopened: the card already has the most open comments it can have ({max}).

board.work.send.alreadySent.note: Sending a card's line comments was refused: this very send was made already (a second click, or a retry).

board.work.send.changed.text: The card changed since you opened this: look again.
board.work.send.changed.note: Sending a card's line comments to its builder was refused: since the preview opened, the card got a new submission, a new decision, or a reviewer started or ended a review.

board.work.send.integrated.text: This card’s work is merged already: its comments can’t go back to the builder.
board.work.send.integrated.note: Sending a card's line comments to its builder was refused: the card's work has been merged into its target already.

board.work.send.itemsChanged.text: A comment changed since you opened this (edited, resolved or deleted): look again.
board.work.send.itemsChanged.note: Sending a card's line comments was refused: one of the comments in the preview was edited, resolved or deleted since it opened.

board.work.send.noBuilder.text: This card has no builder to send its comments to.
board.work.send.noBuilder.note: Sending a card's line comments was refused: no agent built the card's work (it has no builder). Glossary: builder.

board.work.send.notHere.text: Comments can be sent to the builder from Review or Approved only.
board.work.send.notHere.note: Sending a card's line comments to its builder was refused: the card is in another column (Doing, Todo, Done…). Glossary: builder.

board.work.send.nothing.text: There are no open comments to send.
board.work.send.nothing.note: Sending a card's line comments was refused: none of its comments is open.

board.work.send.reviewing.text: {reviewer} is reviewing this card: confirm replacing its review to send your comments.
board.work.send.reviewing.note: Sending a card's line comments was refused: a reviewer agent ({reviewer}, its name) is reviewing the card, and the send replaces that review only once the user confirms it.
